summary: Iteration 12 — verified the two reported bugs are fixed: (1) CRM Call button now opens a campaign-picker dialog before dialing (call-campaign-dialog with call-campaign-select and confirm-dial-button; NOT clicked for safety); (2) The dialer is no longer hardcoded to 3CX — /api/calls/dial dispatches on integrations.telephony_provider and returns a Twilio-specific 400 when provider='twilio' and twilio_enabled=false, and a 3CX-specific 400 when provider='3cx' and tcx_enabled=false. Also verified the integrations partial-merge regression (PUT with only telephony_provider preserves tcx_url/tcx_extension). Backend pytest: 5/5 pass. UI Playwright: dialog opens from BOTH call-lead-<id> (row) and call-lead-detail-button (detail sheet); dropdown includes 'Ad-hoc call (no campaign)' + 2 campaigns; provider note '(3CX or Twilio) is used automatically' present. Final integrations state restored per task spec.
verified_passing: PUT /api/settings/integrations {telephony_provider:'twilio', twilio_enabled:false} then POST /api/calls/dial → 400 with detail containing 'Twilio is selected but not enabled' (NOT the old '3CX live calling is not enabled').
PUT /api/settings/integrations {telephony_provider:'3cx'} then POST /api/calls/dial (tcx_enabled=false) → 400 with detail mentioning '3CX'.
POST /api/settings/integrations/twilio/test with bogus SID/token → 200 {valid:false} (no real call attempted).

PUT /api/settings/integrations with ONLY {telephony_provider:'3cx'} does NOT wipe other fields — GET still returns tcx_url='citiq.3cx.co.za:5001' and tcx_extension='45214521' (partial merge via $set integrations.<k>).
GET /api/campaigns returns 2 demo campaigns → picker shows both plus Ad-hoc option.
UI: clicking call-lead-<id> row button opens call-campaign-dialog; select has 3 options; confirm-dial-button visible.
UI: opening a lead's detail sheet and clicking call-lead-detail-button ALSO opens the same campaign-picker dialog (openCall is shared).
UI copy: 'The active telephony provider (3CX or Twilio) is used automatically based on your Settings.' present in dialog.
safety_notes: Did NOT click confirm-dial-button. Did NOT POST /api/calls/dial with any provider ENABLED. Did NOT POST /api/campaigns/{id}/dial-next. Twilio /test used bogus creds only.

Final Settings→Integrations state (verified via GET): telephony_provider='3cx', twilio_enabled=false, twilio_account_sid='', tcx_url='citiq.3cx.co.za:5001', tcx_extension='45214521', tcx_enabled=false — matches task-spec cleanup requirements.
critical_code_review_comments: Leads.jsx line 193 & 265: static tooltip/button label still says 'Call via 3CX' regardless of the selected telephony provider. Minor UX polish — could read 'Call via {provider}' based on GET /api/settings/integrations.telephony_provider, or just 'Call' to be provider-agnostic (matches the dialog's provider-agnostic messaging).

routes.py place_outbound_call falls back to '3cx' when telephony_provider is empty/None — that's sensible today, but if a tenant has ONLY Twilio configured with an empty provider field it will still 400 with the 3CX message. Not a bug per current spec, just worth noting.
Frontend confirmDial toast reads data.provider ('twilio' or '3cx') from the API response — good, this future-proofs the UI once real dials happen.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical selectors + both entry points verified)

seed_data_creation: None. Integrations were toggled and restored to task-spec baseline as part of pytest teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fixes for provider-aware dialing (Twilio vs 3CX dispatch in place_outbound_call) and CRM campaign picker (Leads.jsx confirmDial flow) are both verified. Selectors: call-lead-<id>, call-lead-detail-button, call-campaign-dialog, call-campaign-select, confirm-dial-button.
